_readme: Crew roster. Keep names identical to the 'director' / 'cinematographer' fields in projects.json.

team.name: ELARA VANCE
team.bio: Former documentary filmmaker and fashion photographer. Oversees all overarching creative vision and tonal consistency across LOST IN FRAME productions.

team.name: LIAM CHEN
team.bio: Member of the Cinematographers Guild with 14 years behind large-format Arri and 35mm cameras. Specialist in high-speed optical capture and low-light street cinematography.

team.name: SOPHIA BENNETT
team.bio: Veteran producer managing multi-million dollar global campaigns across North America, Europe, and Asia. Specializes in complex multi-country location permitting and stunt safety.

team.name: KENJI TANAKA
team.bio: Pioneered procedural Houdini particle dynamics and real-time LED volume virtual production pipelines. Part of the team behind the UK Music Video Awards winner CHRONO OBSCURA.

team.name: CHLOE DUBOIS
team.bio: Architectural graduate turned production designer. Creates physical studio sets, custom props, and sculptural environments that challenge traditional spatial dimensions.

team.name: MARCO ROSSI
team.bio: Analog modular synth purist and certified Dolby Atmos mix engineer. Composes custom acoustic-electronic hybrid film scores that drive physical emotional impact.

team.name: LUNA KIM
team.bio: Bridges graphic design, typography, and 3D kinetic interaction. Designs award-winning title sequences and interactive digital installations.

team.name: DAVID PETERS
team.bio: Rhythmic film editor known for unconventional pacing, split-second match cuts, and tension-building narrative pacing.
